title: margin-review/list
description: The `margin list --json` projection, version 1. The output is a versioned envelope so a reader can detect a future breaking shape change in-band and refuse to guess at unknown fields. This schema is the canonical, committed definition of that output; `margin schema` prints it and the embedded margin-review skill points at it.

revision_id.description: The change the annotation is anchored to, or `(working copy)` for an uncommitted change (see ReviewTarget::WORKING_COPY).

id.description: UUID; pass to `margin status` (a unique prefix is accepted).

file.description: Repository-root-relative path of the anchored file.

type.description: Annotation taxonomy. Omitted when the annotation is a plain note.

body.description: The reviewer's text — the actual request.

side.description: `old` anchors a deleted line; `location` then refers to the commit's parent.

location.description: Current 1-based [start, end] line range. `null` when the anchor is orphaned.

orphaned.description: True when the anchor no longer resolves, whatever the status.

revision_state.description: How the annotated change stands in history. Omitted when the backend cannot track change identity (an annotation on git's working copy).

current_commit.description: The change's current commit when it differs from the captured one. Present only when revision_state is `amended`.

anchored_text.description: The lines the annotation was attached to (use to relocate if orphaned).

addressed_by.description: Revisions already recorded as addressing the annotation.

history.description: Outcomes recorded so far, oldest first.

text.description: The reply or reopen reason recorded with the transition.

revision.description: The change linked as addressing the annotation. Present only on an `addressed_by` action.
